architecture_principles: a discovered material regularity is only usable inside the chemistry family in which it was measured
a scientific applicability boundary is executable code, not prompt advice
the language model may criticize the rule and may not override it
value of information is computed by a deterministic tool over the admissible set only
held-out result data are structurally removed before any payload is assembled
every gate decision carries a machine-readable reason and is serialized with the run

arm_difference_declaration.forbidden_confound: Hiding applicability information from V5_NO_GATE while showing it to V5_FULL is prohibited by protocol v1.1.
held_identical: model endpoint and stage model assignment
evidence access profile and filtered evidence state
raw assess_shared_shape_applicability outputs for every candidate
the full inadmissible-card list and its machine-readable reasons
VOI implementation, weights and tie epsilon
arm_difference_declaration.information_parity_evidence: build_pre_enforcement_payload() takes no arm argument, and its SHA-256 is written into every run as pre_enforcement_payload_sha256. The two arms must report the same hash.
arm_difference_declaration.only_intended_difference: whether the identical chemistry-domain applicability audit is enforced as hard experiment-card admissibility before VOI and at freeze
arm_difference_declaration.payload_consequence: Both arms receive the same audit, the same per-candidate applicability outputs and the same inadmissible-card list. V5_NO_GATE marks the audit advisory and keeps every card selectable; V5_FULL marks it binding and removes the inadmissible cards from the ranked set.

candidate_space.rationale: V5 reuses the byte-identical V3/V4 lattice so that the measured change is the chemistry-domain constraint, not the search space.

architecture.canonical_flow: planner(intent + failure mode) -> mandatory chemistry-audited local science tool -> deterministic chemistry-domain applicability audit (identical and model-visible in both arms) -> enforcement (V5_FULL only) -> VOI over the selectable set -> proposer -> skeptic -> robustness adjudicator -> judge -> freeze

rules: M-HOLD-120 is admissible: it measures thermal-hold drift directly and does not use the shared thermal-response shape.
M-REPEAT is admissible: it measures realization/state spread directly.
M-SWEEP is admissible: it is the direct verification measurement for a chemistry-shifted candidate.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use equal to allowed_with_state_anchor, or when configs/verified_shape_transfer.json records a completed direct sweep for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification. This is deterministic inadmissibility, not a VOI penalty and not prompt advice.

architecture.claim_boundary: V5.0.0 selects an experiment from pre-result evidence under an outcome-blind runtime with a deterministic chemistry-domain admissibility constraint. A V5 result is evidence about executable scientific constraints on measurement choice. It is not a wet-lab result and does not claim that the historical decision used this ranking.
architecture.manuscript_boundary: V5 run results must not be written into manuscript/MAIN_TEXT_V5.md or manuscript/SUPPLEMENTARY_INFORMATION_V5.md until the run series is audited and explicitly frozen by the author.
architecture.name: PUR_NEW_CHEMISTRY_GATED_EXPERIMENT_SELECTION_AGENT_V5
non_goals: adding a language model to compute value of information or admissibility
adding Agent roles beyond planner, tools, proposer, skeptic, robustness adjudicator, judge and freeze
re-running, rewriting or reinterpreting the frozen V4 series

primary_arms.role: advice-only control isolating the incremental effect of turning identical scientific applicability information into an executable hard constraint
prospective chemistry-aware Agent V5 with executable scientific constraints

architecture.purpose: Test whether an experimentally discovered material regularity and its chemistry-domain boundary can be executed as a hard scientific constraint on which measurement an outcome-blind Agent is allowed to select.

stages.role: identify the physical failure mode and the scientific question the next experiment must answer, and request the evidence needed to judge experiments rather than formulations
execute read-only scientific tools. The chemistry-audited local rheology summary is mandatory and is forced into the trace whether or not the planner requested it.

deterministic, non-LLM measurement-applicability audit. Computed once per run without reference to the arm, fully visible to the model in both arms, serialized in full, and never produced by a model stage.
V5_FULL only. Converts the identical audit into hard admissibility before VOI ranking and again at freeze. It cannot be overridden by any model stage.
propose the experiment with the highest scientific information value from the cards present in the payload
attack the proposed experiment on hypothesis coverage, confounding, interpretability and whether its falsification criterion can actually be met
adjudicate whether the proposed experiment survives the reported weight sensitivity and the strongest objection
commit to one experiment card present in the payload, or abstain, and state its acceptance and falsification criteria
programmatically validate and freeze the experiment card. A selection outside the admissible set is rejected at freeze rather than repaired.

architecture.supersedes_nothing: V5 is a new prospective runtime. configs/agent_v4.json, scripts/run_agent_v4.py, prompts/agent_v4_*.txt, src/pur_new/voi.py and every frozen V3/V4 run record remain unchanged and are not reinterpreted by V5.

voi_tool.explicitly_not: distance to any held-out formulation. No target coordinate enters any component, weight or tie-break.
voi_tool.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk
voi_tool.name: score_experiment_cards

decision_stability_sent_to_model.evaluated_over: the selectable experiment cards of this arm
decision_stability_sent_to_model.metric_is_not: model confidence; posterior probability; calibrated expected information
decision_stability_sent_to_model.voi_formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.

evidence_policy.description: For prospective/blind Agent evaluation. The Agent may see original-system measurements and external analogue evidence, but not the target validation formulation identity, its wet-lab outcome, or any outcome-derived labels.

judge_normalized.acceptance_criterion: Let delta_level be the directly measured percent change in the candidate's matched-temperature viscosity level relative to the unmodified reactive-core reference. Accept exactly one registered level hypothesis if delta_level is within plus or minus 3.40 percentage points of its prediction: H-LEVEL-DILUTE at -42.76%, H-LEVEL-ASSOC at 17.24%, or H-LEVEL-PLASTIC at -72.76%. The 120 and 130 C viscosity levels must also be reported directly from the sweep.
judge_normalized.chemistry_support_statement: The primary viscosity-level observable is directly measured across 80-130 C in the resin-modified candidate and therefore does not depend on transferring a rheological regularity from the unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI family. The candidate chemistry itself is outside the previously validated shared-shape family, so E_eta is only a fitted formulation-level rheological descriptor and not evidence of molecular mechanism or validated shape transfer.
judge_normalized.falsification_criterion: H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if delta_level is more than 3.40 percentage points from -42.76%. H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if delta_level is at or below -42.76%. H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if delta_level is at or above -42.76%. If delta_level lies outside all three plus-or-minus 3.40-point prediction bands, all three registered level hypotheses are falsified or unresolved by the declared resolution, and no modifier-specific mechanism is established.
judge_normalized.next_experiment_if_falsified: Run the selectable state-control card S1C41::M-REPEAT to estimate between-preparation realization spread, then repeat direct M-SWEEP measurements with independently prepared, fully documented states and matched single-axis controls for AC1920 at 15% and TK100 at 5% before attributing the result to either modifier axis.
judge_normalized.primary_observable: Directly measured viscosity level at 120 and 130 C, expressed as the percent change relative to the matched unmodified reactive-core reference; the 80-130 C sweep also yields the fitted rheological temperature-response descriptor E_eta.
judge_normalized.rationale: M-SWEEP is admissible under the binding chemistry audit because it directly measures the modified chemistry across the decision-temperature range. It provides the strongest available discrimination among inert dilution, associative elevation, and plasticizing depression while avoiding the inadmissible one-point shared-shape reconstruction. The result cannot isolate the two modifier axes or establish hot-hold stability, and the large realization-state uncertainty requires conservative interpretation.
judge_normalized.stage_disagreements_resolved: I followed the Proposer and Robustness Adjudicator in retaining S1C41::M-SWEEP, but followed the Skeptic in restricting the claim to directly measured formulation-level viscosity and downgrading the 3.40% threshold from a demonstrated candidate-specific uncertainty bound to a declared discrimination criterion. I selected S1C41 over the deterministic tied alternatives because it has the smallest acrylic loading in the tied set while retaining the supported 5% minor-tackifier region.

uncertainty_decomposition.evidence_coverage_uncertainty: High for modifier-specific attribution: the dual-axis candidate tests AC1920 and TK100 together, and the runtime external-prior query returned no rows; analogue support is only provisional design evidence.
uncertainty_decomposition.extrapolation_uncertainty: Low for the 120-130 C viscosity level because it is measured directly; high for any assumed transfer of the unmodified shared thermal shape or interpretation of E_eta beyond this fitted sweep.
uncertainty_decomposition.measurement_uncertainty: The catalogued M-SWEEP discrimination resolution is 3.40 percentage points, but this is a regression residual and not a demonstrated uncertainty bound for the modified candidate.
uncertainty_decomposition.realization_state_uncertainty: High: M-SWEEP specifies one preparation without process-state controls, while the original E2 realizations showed approximately 2.80-3.57x matched-temperature spread and sample CV of approximately 0.46-0.58.

planner.chemistry_support_statement: The local rheological regularities were measured in the original PUR reactive-core family represented by E1, E2, and E3, with the E1 +P chemical perturbation treated separately. An experiment introducing acrylic-like or tackifier-like modifiers would be a chemistry extension and must not be assumed to remain inside that validated support until the audited chemistry boundary is checked.
planner.failure_mode: Unreliable realization of the processing-window viscosity level, with substantial state-to-state spread and no measured modifier-axis response to establish whether a candidate remains inside the 120-130 C window.
planner.failure_mode_evidence: The original E2 temperature sweeps show large matched-temperature realization spread: sample CV is approximately 0.46-0.58 and the max/min ratio is approximately 2.80-3.57 across 80-130 C; no modified-candidate level measurement is present.
planner.least_resolved_justification: Only two original thermal-hold runs are available: one E1 run and one E5 run, each with four points from 15 to 90 minutes at 120 C. There is no hold trajectory for a modifier-containing candidate, whereas temperature response has six-point sweeps for E1-E3 and the realized level has repeated E2 observations, despite their large spread.
measurement_requirements: Measure the candidate's realized viscosity directly with an 80-130 C sweep in 10 C increments, rather than reconstructing 120-130 C values from a single anchor.
Use independently prepared, fully recorded process states and sufficient repeats to distinguish the predicted level differences from the observed E2 realization spread.
Report the matched-temperature level relative to the same unmodified reactive-core reference so that inert-dilution, associative-elevation, and plasticizing-depression predictions are separable.
Measure a 120 C isothermal trajectory at 15, 30, 45, and 60 minutes with at least two independent repeats to determine whether residence-time drift adds a processing failure mode.
planner.scientific_question: At matched temperature and controlled process state, does adding the modifier axis change the realized viscosity according to inert dilution, acrylic-associative elevation, or plasticizing depression, and does the resulting level remain within the 120-130 C processing window?

planner_action_requests_after_forcing.name: query_external_priors
planner_action_requests_after_forcing.reason: Local chemistry coverage for modifier-containing candidates is sparse, so source-level analogue evidence is needed to assess the chemistry-family boundary and formulate a defensible modifier-axis experiment.

proposer.chemistry_support_assessment: The candidate is resin-modified chemistry outside the unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI family in which the shared thermal-response regularity was measured. Because M-SWEEP measures the viscosity level directly across the decision-temperature range, its primary observable does not depend on transferring that unvalidated shared shape. The E_eta descriptor is fit-derived and should be interpreted as a secondary descriptor, not as independently validated chemistry transfer.

outcome_interpretation.if_acceptance_criterion_met: The measured 120-130 C level change relative to the unmodified reactive core will support exactly one registered prediction within the 3.40% resolution: H-LEVEL-DILUTE at -42.76%, H-LEVEL-ASSOC at 17.24%, or H-LEVEL-PLASTIC at -72.76%. The corresponding processing-window level is then reported directly from the sweep.
outcome_interpretation.if_falsification_criterion_met: H-LEVEL-ASSOC is falsified if the measured change is at or below -42.76%; H-LEVEL-PLASTIC is falsified if it is at or above -42.76%; and H-LEVEL-DILUTE is falsified if the measured change departs from -42.76% by more than 3.40%.
outcome_interpretation.if_intermediate: A result not within 3.40% of exactly one prediction leaves the three level hypotheses unresolved for this composition and indicates either an unregistered modifier interaction, inadequate process-state control, or measurement variation larger than the declared discrimination resolution. It would not establish the stability hypotheses or thermal-hold behavior.

proposer.primary_observable: Directly measured viscosity level across 80-130 C, including the realized 120-130 C processing-window level; the accompanying E_eta descriptor is obtained by regression of ln(eta) versus 1/T.

ranked_alternatives.why_lower_value: It is genuinely VOI-tied, but uses a larger 17.5% acrylic intervention without increasing hypothesis discrimination or direct measurement interpretability.
It is genuinely VOI-tied, but uses a larger 20% acrylic intervention and therefore departs further from the characterized reactive-core chemistry.
It is genuinely VOI-tied, but uses a larger 22.5% acrylic intervention, increasing modifier burden without additional registered-hypothesis separation.
It is genuinely VOI-tied, but uses the largest 25% acrylic intervention in the tied set, making it the least conservative first chemistry extension.

proposer.reasoning: M-SWEEP is the highest-VOI admissible measurement plan because it directly measures the processing-window level, separates all three registered level hypotheses, and verifies rather than assumes the temperature response in the modified chemistry. S1C41 is the scientifically preferable tied candidate because its 15% acrylic and 5% minor-tackifier levels are externally supported while minimizing total intervention burden.
proposer.tie_break_justification: The deterministic VOI tool reports genuine indifference among these five cards. S1C41 is selected because it uses the smallest acrylic loading in the tied dual-axis set while remaining within the conservative externally supported acrylic region and the repeatedly supported approximately 5% minor-tackifier region. It therefore provides the smallest justified chemistry departure while retaining full separation of the three registered level hypotheses.

residual_decision_risk: The 3.40% discrimination and falsification resolution is not supported by the specified single preparation and uncontrolled process state.
Historical realization spread may obscure differences among the registered level predictions.
The dual-axis intervention cannot attribute effects to AC1920, TK100, TK100 plasticization, or axis interaction.
The resin-modified chemistry is outside the validated shared-shape support; only the directly measured processing-window level is locally supported.
The fitted E_eta descriptor remains conditional on regression behavior in the modified chemistry and is not a molecular activation energy.
The claimed external support for the 15% acrylic level is provisional and denominator-noncommensurate; the runtime external-prior query returned no rows.
Thermal-hold drift remains unmeasured for the modified candidate.
robustness_adjudication.skeptic_objection_reasoning: The strongest objection is that the specified one-preparation, uncontrolled M-SWEEP cannot credibly support the declared 3.40% falsification resolution in a chemistry with large historical realization spread. This does not change which experiment should be run: M-SWEEP remains the admissible direct measurement of the 80-130 C processing-window level and is preferable to M-ANCHOR for the chemistry extension. It changes how results must be interpreted: the 3.40% criterion should not be treated as an established candidate-specific uncertainty bound, and independently prepared, fully documented replicates and variance-based acceptance criteria are needed. The dual-axis design also cannot isolate acrylic-like, tackifier-like, or interaction effects, so conclusions must remain phenomenological for the combined intervention. E_eta must remain a secondary fitted rheological descriptor, not a molecular activation-energy claim.
robustness_adjudication.weight_sensitivity_assessment: The proposal is in the tied top set. No tested scaling of any weight term from 0.5x to 1.5x changes the tied top set: top_experiment_set_stability is 1.0, intervention-family and measurement-plan stability are both 1.0, and every recommendation_flip_boundary survives the entire sweep. These perturbations are scientifically defensible, but the reported stability is decision stability of the transparent VOI score, not confidence or evidence that the experiment is scientifically correct.

skeptic.chemistry_domain_support_assessment: The primary observable stays inside measured chemistry support only in the limited sense that S1C41 is measured directly by M-SWEEP across 80-130 C; it does not validly reuse the unmodified shared thermal-response shape. The candidate itself remains outside the previously measured chemistry family, and any transfer of the shared shape or interpretation of E_eta beyond a fitted rheological descriptor would require a direct resin-modified sweep and validation of the relevant shape.
skeptic.falsification_criterion_assessment: The protocol can directly measure the 120-130 C level, but it cannot credibly meet the declared 3.40% discrimination criterion as specified. M-SWEEP has min_repeats: 1, controls_process_state: false, and process_state_risk: 0.75, while the original E2 realization spread is orders of magnitude larger than the threshold. The 3.40% number is a shared-shape regression residual, not a demonstrated uncertainty bound for a freshly prepared resin-modified sample.
leakage_findings: The proposer describes the 15% acrylic and 5% tackifier levels as externally supported even though the runtime external-prior query returned no rows and the registry labels the 15% acrylic evidence provisional and denominator-noncommensurate.
No outcome-derived target identity or wet-lab result is used in the payload; the main scope issue is overstatement of analogue evidence, not post-result leakage.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The experiment could support only a phenomenological level classification for the combined AC1920/TK100 intervention, not the claimed mechanism-specific attribution to the acrylic-like axis or to plasticization by both axes.
objections.objection: The selected formulation S1C41 changes both modifier axes simultaneously: AC1920 is 15.0% and TK100 is 5.0%. H-LEVEL-ASSOC depends only on the acrylic_like axis, whereas H-LEVEL-PLASTIC depends on the sum of both axes. A single dual-axis composition can compare the three registered aggregate level predictions, but it cannot attribute any observed deviation to acrylic association, tackifier plasticization, an axis interaction, or the individual TK100 effect.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A result classified as H-LEVEL-ASSOC or H-LEVEL-PLASTIC could be overinterpreted as evidence for the named modifier mechanism even though the experiment cannot isolate either axis.
objections.objection: The three scalar predictions for S1C41 are numerically separated relative to the declared 3.40% M-SWEEP threshold: -42.76% for H-LEVEL-DILUTE, 17.24% for H-LEVEL-ASSOC, and -72.76% for H-LEVEL-PLASTIC. Thus the registered level hypotheses are separated in principle. However, the experiment leaves the axis-specific causal alternatives and any interaction hypothesis unregistered and entangled because only one dual-axis composition is tested. The proposer declares H1_formulation_family, H2_functionality, and H3_region as unseparated, but does not declare this dual-axis attribution limitation.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The protocol may produce an intermediate or apparently displaced result because of realization variation, but the registered rules would incorrectly treat it as falsification or unresolved hypothesis separation at a resolution the specified experiment cannot reliably attain.
objections.objection: The stated falsification criterion requires distinguishing a measured level change from the S1C41 predictions at 3.40%, while M-SWEEP specifies only min_repeats: 1 and does not control process state. The payload reports E2 matched-temperature realization spread of 2.80-3.57x, sample CV of approximately 0.46-0.58, pooled one-anchor errors of 1.063-1.099x, six missing process fields, and process_state_risk score 0.75. The 3.40% value is a regression residual from a shared-shape fit, not demonstrated repeatability of a resin-modified preparation.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: A fitted rheological descriptor could be misread as evidence for a molecular temperature-response mechanism, despite the payload's explicit boundary that E_eta is not a reaction activation energy.
objections.objection: The primary 120-130 C viscosity level in M-SWEEP is directly measured, so it is stronger than M-ANCHOR and does not require thermal-shape extrapolation. However, the accompanying E_eta descriptor is obtained by regressing ln(eta) versus 1/T and the catalog explicitly assigns interpretability 0.7. The proposer correctly calls E_eta secondary, but the acceptance language should prevent E_eta from being treated as an independently direct observable or as a chemical activation energy.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: Treating the E_eta fit or any unmeasured-temperature inference as validated shape transfer would overextend the unmodified-family evidence, although the directly measured processing-window level itself remains interpretable.
objections.objection: The candidate is outside the measured unmodified PPG2000/PDP70/MDI family, and the audit marks S1C41 as modified_chemistry_unvalidated with shared_shape_use: verification_only. The proposal appropriately selects M-SWEEP, which directly measures 80-130 C and therefore keeps the primary viscosity level inside the measurement support rather than reusing the unmodified shared shape. Only the fitted E_eta descriptor still involves a model fit, and no validated resin-modified shape transfer is available.

objections.consequence_if_ignored: The experiment's selection rationale could be overstated as chemistry-specific support for AC1920/TK100 rather than a bounded analogue-based design choice.
objections.objection: The payload's external-prior query for the acrylic_like modifier returned an empty result, while the proposer states that S1C41's 15% acrylic and 5% tackifier levels are externally supported. The candidate registry does contain pre-result analogue anchors, but it explicitly says the 15% acrylic evidence is provisional and noncommensurate until its denominator is reverified, and that analogue evidence does not establish an exact AC1920/TK100 outcome or molecular mechanism.

skeptic.recommended_change: Retain M-SWEEP but add independently prepared, fully documented process-state replicates sufficient to estimate candidate-specific realization variance, and predefine acceptance using that variance rather than the 3.40% fit residual. To make modifier attribution available, test a matched single-axis control set, at minimum AC1920 15% without TK100 and TK100 5% without AC1920, alongside the dual-axis S1C41 formulation and the same unmodified reactive-core reference.
skeptic.strongest_objection: The 3.40% falsification resolution is not attainable with the specified M-SWEEP protocol: it uses only one preparation, does not control the process state, and is applied to a chemistry with historical realization spread of 2.80-3.57x and CV of approximately 0.46-0.58. The fit residual reported for M-SWEEP is not evidence that a resin-modified candidate can be classified at 3.40% resolution.

tool_trace.name: get_chemistry_audited_rheology_summary
tool_trace.reason: Load the chemistry-provenance-audited local rheology, shared thermal-response support, state-shift evidence, original hold contrast, and E1 +P compatibility before ranking any candidate or relying on a local regularity.

claim_boundaries: The shared-shape/state-shift structure is established only within the measured local chemistry family.
The apparent E_eta descriptor is rheological, not a chemical reaction activation energy.
The E1/E5 hold contrast does not identify a unique molecular mechanism.
The verified E1 +P phosphoric-acid perturbation is excluded from the primary same-composition fit and is interpreted separately as a chemical-perturbation check.
No validation-formulation identity or outcome is used by this tool.
design_rules: Represent a candidate as formulation plus process/realization state, not composition alone.

Use one state-specific anchor measurement to locate a new realization or nearby local formulation on the transferable thermal-response shape when it remains inside the supported local chemistry family.
Treat static viscosity, temperature response and thermal-hold stability as separate decision variables.
When the failure mode is hot-hold drift, choose an experiment and measurement window that directly test drift rather than only matching one nominal viscosity value.
Use external resin/tackifier evidence to define chemically plausible directions, but do not convert analogue proximity into a predicted local outcome.
Keep deliberately chemistry-perturbed curves outside same-composition fitting, but use them to test whether an intervention shifts viscosity scale, thermal-response shape, or both.

chemical_perturbation_check.interpretation: The verified low-dose H3PO4 perturbation shifts the observed viscosity level while remaining closely compatible with the local shared thermal-response geometry. It is a separate chemical-perturbation check and is not pooled into the primary same-composition state model.

observational_E1_GJJ_day1_comparator.interpretation_boundary: Observational reference only; the compact record does not establish a paired parent-batch relationship between E1 +P and E1 GJJ day-1.

one_point_state_calibration.interpretation: Within the tested local chemistry family, one state-specific viscosity anchor can locate a previously held-out nominal formulation on the shared thermal-response shape to roughly 6-10% pooled multiplicative error.
one_point_state_calibration.validation_scheme: leave one nominal formulation out; fit shared shape on the remaining formulations; use one anchor from the held formulation

state_shift_master_curve.interpretation: Within the chemistry-audited local family, a realization-specific viscosity-scale intercept plus a shared quadratic inverse-temperature response closes the data far better than a formulation-level intercept using the same thermal basis.

temporal_stability_coordinate.interpretation: Original E1 and E5 hold trajectories show that thermal-hold viscosity drift is strongly formulation dependent and should be treated separately from static viscosity.

thermal_coordinate.interpretation: The apparent temperature-sensitivity descriptor remains comparatively concentrated after chemistry auditing; it is a rheological descriptor, not a molecular reaction activation energy.

experiment_design_implications.hold_window: For the current local study, 120 C and the common 15-60 min window directly interrogate the observed instability while matching the available validation window.
experiment_design_implications.selection_target: Select a formulation-process point that is informative about the observed instability and state uncertainty, not merely the closest static-viscosity value.
experiment_design_implications.state_anchor: A single in-range anchor can be used for efficient local curve calibration; 120 C is operationally attractive because it is also the hold-stability test temperature.
experiment_design_implications.verified_acid_perturbation: E1 +P received 0.025 mmol H3PO4 from a 0.1 mol/L standard solution during dehydration. tool_trace.name: get_candidate_hypothesis
tool_trace.reason: Retrieve the evidence-derived candidate-space axes and boundaries needed to define a modifier-containing experiment without using the blinded validation formulation or outcome.

evidence: PAT_US20160215185A1: repeated acrylic tackifying resin examples at approximately 19-20% of total formulation
PAT_US6465104B1 Example 10: 25 wt% low-OH acrylic copolymer with direct 121 C viscosity-stability data
PAPER_CN_ADHESIVES_2025_34_09_54: reports a 15% preferred acrylic-resin addition level, retained as directional lower-bound evidence until its fraction denominator is reverified
acrylic_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 20 and 25% are directly commensurate coarse anchors in the current curated record. The 15% grid level is retained as a lower-bound design point, but the literature denominator for the reported 15% addition level is not treated as an exact total-formulation anchor until reverified.

evidence: PAT_US5932680A: examples around 4.8-6.4% tackifying/hydrocarbon resin and preferred resin range 3-10 wt%
PAT_US20070155859A1: tackifiers/rheology-control agents typically used below about 10 wt%
minor_tackifier_like_modifier_pct_total.interpretation: 5% represents the repeatedly documented minor-resin region and 10% is a conservative coarse upper level.

result.claim_boundary: External examples are analogues. They support candidate-family and coarse-region hypotheses, not an exact optimum for AC1920/TK100 and not a proven local molecular mechanism. The current reconstruction uses only pre-result evidence at runtime; the exact validation coordinates and outcome are excluded from candidate construction, ranking and tie-breaking.

decision_policy.claim_boundary: This policy can recover an evidence-supported formulation neighborhood, but it is not a predictor of the exact wet-lab optimum.

acrylic_like.basis: 15% directional lower-region evidence plus directly commensurate ~19-20% examples; 25% remains directly supported but is a larger perturbation.

minor_tackifier_like.basis: Curated PUR examples repeatedly place tackifying/hydrocarbon resin near 5%, with broader guidance below about 10%.

experiment_intents.causal_isolation: Use when the primary objective is attribution of one formulation axis. Prefer a single active modifier axis only in this mode.
experiment_intents.performance_mitigation: Use when a measured failure mode is already established and the next experiment is intended to reduce that failure. Independently supported multi-modifier interventions are admissible.
experiment_intents.uncertainty_resolution: Use when missing process, stoichiometric or evidence information prevents an interpretable performance test.

decision_policy.purpose: Select an experimentally informative intervention from pre-result evidence without treating a literature composition as the hidden optimum.
ranking_rules: Exact distance to an external analogue anchor is audit metadata, not a primary optimization objective.
Candidates in the same evidence-support class are not rewarded merely for being numerically closer to a literature percentage.
For performance mitigation, two modifier axes may be combined when each is independently supported and the combination stays inside bounded evidence regions.

Among candidates with comparable evidence coverage and interpretability, prefer the smallest sufficient total modifier burden and the smallest justified departure from the characterized local chemistry.
A single-variable design is preferred only when causal attribution is the stated experiment intent; it is not a universal default.
Held-out validation coordinates and outcomes must never enter candidate construction, ranking or tie-breaking.

historical_status.interpretation: The prospective historical claim attaches to the Agent recommendation itself. The current coarse grid and fine-refinement software are later reproducible operationalizations of the evidence-constrained region and are not represented as the original contemporaneous freeze algorithm unless older provenance is recovered.

local_reactive_core_anchor.reason: E2 is the geometric centre of the original five-point local design: 50/50 PPG2000/PDP-70 and NCO:OH=1.80, centered between E1/E3 stoichiometric perturbations and E4/E5 composition perturbations.
local_reactive_core_anchor.stoichiometry_note: The E2 NCO:OH=1.80 label applies to the original reactive core. If a modifier contributes reactive OH or another NCO-reactive group, true stoichiometry must be recalculated from verified material specifications.

stability_hypotheses.H1_formulation_family: Partial replacement of the reactive-only formulation by an acrylic-like and/or minor tackifier-like resin can reduce hot-hold viscosity drift under matched process conditions.
stability_hypotheses.H2_functionality: At comparable acrylic loading, lower effective reactive-group density or lower-OH acrylic chemistry is expected to be more favorable for hot-hold viscosity stability than more highly reactive acrylic chemistry.
stability_hypotheses.H3_region: A useful candidate region is expected within the externally supported coarse space spanned by 15-25% acrylic-like modifier and 0-10% minor tackifier-like modifier, while preserving the relative E2 reactive-core proportions.

chemistry_applicability_audit.enforcement_note: In this condition the chemistry applicability audit is BINDING. The cards it marks inadmissible were removed before ranking and are not selectable. You may state that you disagree with the rule and why; naming a removed card is an invalid output.
rule_text: Scope: measurement admissibility, not formulation admissibility.
M-HOLD-120, M-REPEAT and M-SWEEP observe their quantity directly and remain admissible.

M-ANCHOR is admissible only when assess_shared_shape_applicability returns shared_shape_use == 'allowed_with_state_anchor', or when a versioned prior direct sweep has verified transferability for the same chemistry family.
Otherwise M-ANCHOR is inadmissible_before_shape_verification: the one-point anchor would reconstruct 120-130 C viscosity through a shape that has never been measured for that chemistry.
This audit is a deterministic scientific rule, not a VOI penalty and not a model opinion. Whether it is binding in this run is stated by the enforcement field.

voi.formula: VOI = w_hyp * hypothesis_discrimination + w_unc * uncertainty_reduction + w_dec * decision_relevance + w_int * measurement_interpretability - w_ext * extrapolation_risk - w_proc * process_state_risk. Every component is normalized to [0, 1] by construction. This is a transparent normalized score with reported weight sensitivity, not a Bayesian posterior.
voi.tie_note: These experiments share an identical component vector. The deterministic tool is indifferent among them. Any choice within this set must be justified scientifically.
